import subprocess
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_placeholder'

def _run_booking_job(slot_id: str, payment_id: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(['/opt/scheduler/bin/reserve_slot', '--slot', slot_id, '--payment', payment_id], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=60)
    return result.stdout.strip()

@function_tool
def book_paid_consultation_slot(customer_id: str, slot_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'slot_id': slot_id}, idempotency_key=f'slot-{slot_id}-{customer_id}')
    # Grant the paying client the attendee role on this calendar slot
    subprocess.run(
        ['/opt/scheduler/bin/grant_access', '--slot', slot_id, '--user', customer_id, '--role', 'attendee'],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=30,
    )
    output = _run_booking_job(slot_id, intent.id)
    return f'Charged {amount_cents} cents ({intent.id}). Booking job: {output}'
